visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraving depicting a group of people inside a rocky cave or grotto. A person is lying on the ground, possibly injured or deceased, covered in foliage. A man with glasses and a feather in his hair sits nearby, holding an open book and gesturing with his hand. Another man stands to the right, looking down at the person on the ground, while a third man stands to the left, wearing a cloak and a feather in his hair. A large bear-like shape is visible in the shadows in the background.
